question: Should OpenClaw accept longest-prefix reload rule matching as the supported contract for overlapping plugin reload prefixes in this PR?
rationale: That precedence change is generic reload-planner behavior and compatibility-sensitive config behavior, so maintainers should explicitly accept it even though the browser fix itself is narrow and well tested.

options.title: Accept After Docs Update
options.body: Update the browser docs for the new reload contract, then proceed with maintainer merge review using longest-prefix matching as the intended planner behavior.

options.title: Accept Runtime First
options.body: Merge the runtime fix now and track docs separately, accepting a short-lived documentation mismatch for browser profile reload behavior.

options.title: Pause For Policy Review
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide a broader reload-prefix precedence policy or a narrower browser-specific exception is preferred.

recommendation.title: Accept After Docs Update
recommendation.body: Update the browser docs for the new reload contract, then proceed with maintainer merge review using longest-prefix matching as the intended planner behavior.
